reason: The current SEIS shell already supports responsive layout, offline readiness, reduced motion, static hosting, and server handoff without adding native build complexity.

options.label: PWA-first
strengths: keeps release and server packaging simple

options.label: Expo / React Native
strengths: faster native prototyping than fully native
tradeoffs: requires separate motion and accessibility QA

options.label: Native Swift + Kotlin
tradeoffs: duplicates UI and motion decisions across platforms

decisionGate: Keep PWA-first until native-only capabilities become a product requirement.
